import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

def raw_req(body=b'', lines=None, method='MESSAGE', target='sip:bob@lab.test'):
    if lines is None: lines = []
    text = method + ' ' + target + ' SIP/2.0'
    for l in lines: text += '\r\n' + l
    return text.encode('latin-1') + b'\r\n\r\n' + body

def test(name, lines, expect, target='sip:bob@lab.test', method='MESSAGE', body=b''):
    d = basic_doc()
    d['events']=[ev(w=raw_req(body=body, lines=lines, target=target, method=method))]
    out = decisions(d)
    if isinstance(out, tuple):
        print('FAIL(crash)', name, out); return
    r = out['results'][0]
    got = r.get('reason') or r.get('decision')
    if got != expect:
        print('FAIL', name, '->', got, 'want', expect, r)

STD = ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t", "To: <sip:bob@lab.test>", "Call-ID: c1", "CSeq: 1 MESSAGE", "Content-Length: 0"]

# folding
test('fold from', ["Fro","m: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'headers')
test('fold ok', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;ta","g=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')
test('fold with space', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0","X-Foo: bar","\t baz"], 'accept')
test('fold tab only', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;ta","\tg=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')
test('continuation no prev', ["\tfoo","From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'syntax')
test('header ws before colon', ["From : <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')
test('header tab before colon', ["From\t: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')
test('header no space after colon', ["From:<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To:<sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID:c1","CSeq:1 MESSAGE","Content-Length:0"], 'accept')
test('header empty value ignored', STD + ["X-Foo:"], 'accept')
test('header empty value required', ["From:","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'headers')
test('lowercase names', ["from: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","to: <sip:bob@lab.test>","call-id: c1","cseq: 1 MESSAGE","content-length: 0"], 'accept')
test('compact names', ["f: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","t: <sip:bob@lab.test>","i: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","l: 0"], 'accept')
test('compact uppercase', ["F: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","T: <sip:bob@lab.test>","I: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","L: 0"], 'accept')
test('compact and long dup', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","f: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'headers')
test('cseq method mismatch', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 INVITE","Content-Length: 0"], 'fields')
test('cseq tabs', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq:\t1\tMESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')

test('callid 65', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: "+('c'*65),"CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'fields')

test('to display name', ["From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t","To: \"Bob\" <sip:bob@lab.test>","Call-ID: c1","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"], 'accept')

test('pai two rows', STD + ["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>","P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>"], 'accept')
test('ppi two rows', STD + ["P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>","P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@lab.test>"], 'accept')
test('ppi three rows', STD + ["P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>","P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@lab.test>","P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>"], 'fields')
test('pai comma in quoted dn', STD + ['P-Asserted-Identity: "A, B" <sip:alice@lab.test>'], 'accept')
test('pai empty item between', STD + ['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>,, <tel:+12025550100>'], 'fields')
# privacy
test('privacy two rows id', STD + ["Privacy: id","Privacy: id"], 'accept')
test('privacy two rows mix', STD + ["Privacy: id","Privacy: none"], 'fields')
test('privacy semicolon', STD + ["Privacy: id;id"], 'accept')
test('privacy none', STD + ["Privacy: none"], 'accept')
test('privacy uppercase', STD + ["Privacy: ID"], 'accept')
test('privacy junk', STD + ["Privacy: id;none"], 'fields')
test('privacy semicolon empty', STD + ["Privacy: id;"], 'fields')
print('done')
